assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Given the history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia and the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, a 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events.
The service is medically necessary to support the documented diagnoses of I49.9 and I48.0.
The claim for CPT code 93226, representing a 48-hour Holter monitoring study, has been denied.
The denial is based on reason code PR-204.
This specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
Please review the attached Explanation of Benefits for further details regarding coverage limitations.
If you disagree with this determination, you have the right to file an appeal.
Appeals must be submitted in writing within ninety days of the date of this notice.
Include all supporting clinical documentation and a detailed letter of medical necessity to facilitate a thorough review of the case.
